svg.title: Signs of r(x) = (x + 1)(x − 3)/(x − 1)
svg.desc: The graph of r(x) = (x + 1)(x − 3)/(x − 1). Its zeros are x = −1 and x = 3; the dashed line x = 1 marks the input that is not in the domain. The output is negative for x < −1, positive for −1 < x < 1, negative for 1 < x < 3 and positive for x > 3.
